violated_assumptions: Defect assumes Qdrant should auto-create vector config when points are inserted with vectors, even when collection was created without explicit vectors parameter

contract_refs: endpoint: collections+{collection_name} (PUT), line 42: vectors is 'required': false (optional parameter)
endpoint: collections+{collection_name}+points (PUT), line 332-390: points parameter requires vector data but does not specify auto-creation behavior
contract_grounding.note: Contract shows vectors is optional at collection creation time, but contains NO assertion that vectors will be auto-created when omitted. No contract violation exists.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: PUT /collections/{name}/points → upsert_points (update_api.rs:54) → do_upsert_points → PointInsertOperations processing → vectors.check_vector_names (types.rs:1736) → collection.vectors.get_params fails (empty vectors map) → OperationError::vector_name_not_exists → HTTP 400
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:Collection created with only {shard_number: 1} has empty vectors config (vectors参数未提供). check_vector_names函数显式验证vector name是否存在,当vectors map为空时,任何vector name都会触发VectorNameNotExists错误.这是by-design行为,不是bug.

falsification.probe: Create collection with proper vectors config: PUT /collections/test_with_vectors {vectors: {size: 4, distance: Cosine}, shard_number: 1} then insert points
falsification.observed: HTTP 200 OK, point successfully inserted. Error only occurs when collection created WITHOUT vectors config.
falsification.evidence_cmd: curl -s -X PUT 'http://localhost:6333/collections/test_proper' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"vectors": {"size": 4, "distance": "Cosine"}, "shard_number": 1}' && curl -s -X PUT 'http://localhost:6333/collections/test_proper/points?wait=true' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"points": [{"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}]}'

mundane_explanation.note: This is mundane API semantics: Qdrant requires explicit vector configuration at collection creation. Inserting points with vectors into a collection without vector config is correctly rejected.

cognition_match.note: 未命中by_design_patterns. 这是API设计的基本要求:vector config必须显式声明.不是维护者认为'不重要'的边缘情况,而是核心API契约.

verdicts.rationale: Qdrant要求在创建collection时显式配置vectors参数.当仅提供{shard_number: 1}而不配置vectors时,collection的vectors config为空map.后续upsert points时会通过check_vector_names验证(default vector name),由于vectors map为空而触发'Not existing vector name error'.源码(types.rs:1736-1745)显示这是显式验证逻辑,by-design行为.提供正确vectors config后insert成功.这不是bug,是符合API设计的基本语义要求.
